name: Bhudevi Infra Projects Ltd
summary: Bhudevi Infra Projects Limited, a real estate company, develops residential ventures in Telangana, India. The company was formerly known as Aarv Infratel Limited and changed its name to Bhudevi Infra Projects Limited in September 2022. Bhudevi Infra Projects Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
